# Ingestion 2 deletion inventory

Created before deletion on 2026-10-13. Author: Codex.

Target: `/Users/aryamanchandak/Documents/AI OS/Ingestion 2`

The main codebase is `merged-ingestion`, identified by the repository guidance, package manifest, and runtime imports. Its current source files (including uncommitted edits), cockpit API router, operational setup scripts, active Obsidian filter, package manifest, and lockfile are retained in their original paths.

Everything else is scheduled for deletion under the requested code-only cleanup. This includes the local Git repository and its history, development tests and fixtures, old implementations, planning and handoff documents (including modified and untracked documents), sample intake photographs and metadata, duplicate filter configuration, build output, Python caches, and the installed virtual environment. No backup of deleted contents is created. This inventory is outside the target folder so it survives the cleanup.

The retained cockpit is an API router mounted by the external AI OS gateway. Its frontend and host application are external to this folder.

## Verification and runtime prerequisites

- Pre-cleanup verification: 450 tests passed; 1 failed because `/Users/aryamanchandak/Documents/AI OS/llm_gateway/main.py` does not exist. This external dependency was already missing before cleanup.
- `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` reference the external shared gateway at `../../llm_gateway`; cleanup does not change that reference or any runtime source.
- The virtual environment is removed as generated installation output. Recreate it with `bash scripts/bootstrap_environment.sh` once the shared gateway is available at its expected path.
- Runtime also requires the external gateway/services and environment configuration; successful live operation is not established by this cleanup.
- Retained files will be verified against SHA-256 hashes recorded before deletion.
